Results.ReviewText: After a year of ownership, I LOVE my Kettle. Great community support for cooking tips, but two issues are really annoying. First, the top vent has rusted enough that it's very difficult to turn, despite the grill always being covered with a Weber cover. If it had the plastic grip like on the newer grills it might not be such a chore to adjust, but I have to keep a chunk of wood near the grill to bang the vent open and closed when it needs adjustment. The biggest problem for me, though, is the ash catcher. In order to attach/detach the ash catcher, it's necessary to squeeze the two sides of the handle together, The handle's crazy-high spring tension and the fact that the two sides of the handle are only 1.5 inches apart makes it nearly impossible to apply enough force to the handle to free it from the grill. You actually have to make a fist around the handle and then try to squeeze the fist enough to compress the springs... it's a nightmare and I dread having to empty ash catcher every time it gets full.
Results.Title: Great grill except...

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. Have used for everything from burgers and dogs, to slow smoking a pork butt. Gas is perhaps a tad more convenient, but the flavor from charcoal/wood just can't be beat.

Results.ReviewText: Overall, solid value for dollar expected from Weber. Kettle seems a little “thinner” than my older models. Vent on top is very stiff and hard to slide,(even after greasing). Still the best bbq to grill or smoke for under $200.

I have a pellet grill and I don’t use it anymore after purchasing the Weber kettle other than the pizza oven attachment for the pellet grill.
The food is so much better in the kettle, especially with lump charcoal. I’m loving the Weber.

Results.ReviewText: Just as advertised, no frills, no fancy shamcy attachments, but good quality sturdy round container with metal gratings for food charcoal and a sturdy ash catcher. Just what you need in a charcoal grill. I refuse to spend more than $200 on a charcoal grill and I refuse to compromise on quality and durability of materials. So this one fit the bill. Also traps heat well with the lid on. Come on folks do you really need something super fancy for a charcoal grill. Humankind has been cooking food on coal for ages. But you do need a good quality product. So I'd recommend this.

Results.ReviewText: I am absolutely loving my new Weber kettle! I’ve cooked on many grills before and have always overlooked the Webber because of size and price comparison. I currently have a pellet grill which I love, but i was missing the charcoal flavor I’ve always known. I gave Weber a chance because I had limited space to add another pit. I am loving it so much that I would like to find a used one to put at the house I stay at periodically on the weekends.

Results.ReviewText: I've had my original grill for over 30 years and just gave it to my son. I bought a second Premium charcoal grill over 10 years ago (the clean out bucket underneath) and that's mine until I croak. Other than replacing grates once- going strong! Love my Weber originals.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill... as always... I've used Weber Grills for over thirty years.  I wish this one still had the lid holder on the outside of the kettle (as my previous Weber did), rather than the hook inside the lid.  The hook is hard to use, and doesn't hold the lid high enough to act as any sort of wind-break.  Other than that, I love it!

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
